description: Fetch one standard's complete specification record by id, acronym, filename, or RFC number. Returns verified v0.5 fields (v05_infobox_rows, v05_identity_sentence_md, v05_lead_md, v05_problem_md, v05_counterparts, v05_see_also, v05_wire_artifact, v05_last_checked_display), 6-domain bucket (domain), url, probe_rule, has_template, freshness, and evidence. Use get for one standard; compare for two specs or classic bridges; instances for implementations.

id.description: standard id, acronym, filename, or RFC number (e.g. mcp, ard, llms.txt, RFC 9421)

name: get
title: Get a standard
